thread:
Ravi (Product Designer): new UX issue: when you reorder rules in Draft mode, the Preview shows the live ordering. users think reorder didn't apply. small thread.
Lena (PM): ok can you repro?
Ravi (Product Designer): yep on staging. Steps: open policy > toggle Draft > reorder > Preview. Preview header still says policy v12 and legend counts don't match.
Noah (Frontend): sounds like we feed the sim the last-saved snapshot, not the client draft. likely missing state serialization before sim call.
Priya (Accessibility): also flag: the draft marker is a faint orange dot. not keyboard focusable and no aria-label. screen reader users miss it.
Omar (Backend): for now the sim endpoint expects stored snapshots only. we can add an optional payload to accept ephemeral snapshots but need to rate-limit and size-check.
Lena (PM): two paths: quick UX indicating "Previewing saved policy" vs "Previewing draft"; or longer fix sending draft snapshot to sim. which do we want?
Ravi (Product Designer): quick fix options: 1) make Preview button read "Preview draft" when unsaved changes exist and show a dismissible banner "Showing draft changes — these are not saved until you Save"; 2) update legend counts client-side to reflect draft ordering.
Noah (Frontend): option 1+2 doable. I can compute legend counts in the client by reusing normalization code. small risk.
Omar (Backend): for the longer fix I'd accept a POST body with snapshot and a max-size header; reject >1MB and return 413. also add concurrency guard per tenant.
Priya (Accessibility): copy/cue suggestions: Banner: "You are previewing unsaved edits in this policy. Save to make changes live." Draft pill: "Draft — unsaved changes" with role=status and aria-live=polite. ensure it receives keyboard focus via a skip link.
Ravi (Product Designer): good. validation nit: we currently show only a red "Invalid" badge on rules. users want inline hint why. propose: show short reason under rule title, e.g., "Missing match value — add header or path" and a Learn more link.
Noah (Frontend): will implement expandable validation details. small DOM change.
Omar (Backend): note: preview currently skips some save-only validators. we should run the same validators client-side for preview so there are no surprises on Save. I'll publish validator spec.
Lena (PM): action items: Noah spike client legend + preview label/band this sprint. Omar spec snapshot API limits for follow-up. Priya to write accessibility acceptance criteria. Ravi to add copy variants in Figma and attach.
Ravi (Product Designer): copy drafts: Banner short: "Previewing unsaved edits — changes shown are not saved." Banner actions: "Save changes" (primary), "Discard" (secondary). Draft pill: "Draft (unsaved)" tooltip: "You have unsaved changes. Press Ctrl/Cmd+S to save." Validation example: "Missing match value — provide a value for this condition."
Priya (Accessibility): tweak: banner should read "You are previewing unsaved edits in this policy" for context. Tooltips must be keyboard reachable and not the only place to get shortcut info. Use visible helper text where possible.
Noah (Frontend): note on keyboard shortcuts: the S shortcut collides with other nested editors. I'll scope shortcut to top-level policy focus and fall back to Shift+S in nested contexts.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch feat/draft-preview-fix (job #5123).
Lena (PM): timeline: can team deliver quick fixes this sprint?
Noah (Frontend): yes, aiming to ship banner + pill + client legend counts by Thursday. I'll include a11y attributes from Priya.
Omar (Backend): drafting snapshot size guard doc for B.
Ravi (Product Designer): thanks all — I'll post Figma link and attach screenshot in a follow-up message. if anyone sees other preview/draft oddities, drop them here.
